# Zyphuel

> Zyphuel is Pakistan's premier on-demand mobile refueling and energy delivery platform operating in Lahore, Pakistan. We deliver certified Euro-V Diesel and Super Petrol directly to vehicles, generators, fleet yards, construction sites, and commercial facilities with calibrated digital flow meters and real-time GPS tracking.

## Overview
Zyphuel solves fuel procurement challenges across Lahore by dispatching specialized mini-bowsers equipped with certified digital flow meters, anti-static grounding, and emergency safety cutoffs. Our service operates 24/7 with an average delivery window of 45 minutes across all major towns and sectors in Lahore.

## Services Offered
- **Doorstep Vehicle Refueling**: On-demand petrol and diesel delivery directly to personal and executive vehicles at homes, offices, and roadside locations.
- **Generator Refueling**: Scheduled and emergency Euro-V diesel delivery for residential, corporate, medical, and industrial standby generators to eliminate load-shedding downtime.
- **Commercial Fleet Refueling**: Bulk fueling solutions for logistics fleets, transport companies, and delivery vans with unified digital invoicing and fuel consumption tracking.
- **Event & Construction Fueling**: On-site refueling for construction equipment, excavators, and temporary event power generators.
- **Clean Water Tankers**: Bulk commercial and residential clean water delivery across Lahore.
- **Sealed LPG Cylinders**: Safe, certified LPG gas cylinder replacements delivered to doorsteps.

## Service Areas (Lahore, Pakistan)
Gulberg, DHA Lahore (Phases 1-9), Model Town, Johar Town, Bahria Town, Cantt, Faisal Town, Garden Town, WAPDA Town, Canal Road, Cavalry Ground, Shadman, Allama Iqbal Town, Lake City, and surrounding metropolitan areas.

## Core Features & Guarantees
- **Accurate Calibrated Metering**: Real-time calibrated digital meters ensure you receive every drop you pay for with printed and digital receipts.
- **100% Genuine Fuel**: Direct supply chain from certified oil marketing companies (Euro-V compliant).
- **Live GPS Tracking**: Real-time tracking of fuel bowser dispatch, route, and estimated time of arrival.
- **Instant Online & App Booking**: Place fuel orders in seconds via the web platform or official Android mobile application.
